notes.title: an update
notes.content:
A small update has been released.

fixed features
- bg-images attached in a battle against an extra(hidden) major boss enemy.
- the issues playable charactors owned(learnable) a movement "healing light ex2" had no starting-up healing skills
- fixed the issues that the final enemy didn't have the personal "same" skills.
- fully gaming controlers supported. I forgot to change the settings in a store page,sorry.

adjustments
- the final boss uses a magic over 10000 damages dealt against a player with the vitality up to 987HPs in Lvl-99, that magic is adjusted to be more difficult to use.(There is no changes in its damages-power)
- adjusted enemies' AIs owned both movements "healing light ex" and "healing light ex2".


thanks for playing
